'''R-R09''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. There, it managed a small shop, where it also provided the knowledge of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] construction to others.
